About Me

Hi, I’m Kishan, a PhD researcher at the National Centre for Nuclear Research in Warsaw. My research focuses on CMB lensing and the study of systematic effects for CMB experiments. I specialise in building computational tools to recover meaningful signals from complex, noisy data.

My recent work connects cosmology, statistical inference, and scientific computing with projects in data science and machine learning.
